overview: You sat down before four with Field's Holinshed shut. You did not open it. The chronicle only says the thing was done, and you had to say how. You did not walk to the shelf.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Sat to the board with the chronicle shut.

assets.name: the Holinshed
assets.disposition: Set the chronicle at the side of the board

summary: Set the chronicle at the side of the board
